description: This file implements dead code elimination logic for the Torch JIT compiler, including a class DeadCodeEliminator with methods for marking live nodes, handling loops, and removing dead code in computational graphs.

classes.name: DeadCodeEliminator
classes.description: A class that performs dead code elimination on Torch JIT graphs using a mark-and-sweep algorithm, handling special cases like loops and conditional nodes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the dead code elimination process on a given block, marking live nodes and sweeping dead ones.

methods.name: setDeleteCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called with the set of values that are deleted during elimination.

methods.name: eliminateDeadForkInputs
methods.description: Removes unused inputs from fork nodes within a block.

methods.name: markReturnNode
methods.description: Marks the return node and its dependencies as live, handling special cases like loops.

methods.name: markLoop
methods.description: Handles marking nodes within loop constructs until convergence.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks nodes and subgraphs as live, including handling special node types.

methods.name: markIfLive
methods.description: Marks a node if its outputs or memory locations are live.

methods.name: insertLiveValue
methods.description: Inserts a value into the set of live values.

methods.name: liveValuesContains
methods.description: Checks if a value is in the set of live values.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Removes nodes that are not marked as live from the graph.

methods.name: hasSideEffects
methods.description: Determines if a node has side effects or untracked mutations.

methods.name: removeDeadBlockOutputs
methods.description: Removes unused outputs from control flow nodes like if and loop.

methods.name: removeDeadLoopOutputs
methods.description: Removes unused loop outputs and dependencies.
